data.title: Kensington Gardens
data.about:
Kensington Gardens by LEOS Developers is an extraordinary residential community that introduces Dubai’s first crystal healing homes, designed to enhance wellbeing and elevate daily living. Nestled within the serene Greenwood neighborhood, the development offers luxurious 3 to 7-bedroom townhouses and standalone villas. Using British technology, each home integrates crystal healing elements, creating a balanced and harmonious environment. With spacious layouts, premium finishes, and nature-inspired surroundings, Kensington Gardens offers residents a tranquil retreat from the fast-paced city life. 

Located within Dubai’s newest and greenest district, Greenwood, this development combines luxury living with sustainability. Residents can enjoy access to lush green spaces, a central park, and an array of community amenities designed for an active and healthy lifestyle.

characteristics_module.title: An Eco-Luxury Retreat Blending Wellness, Sustainability, and Nature
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Crystal Healing Homes: First-of-its-kind in Dubai, incorporating crystal elements to promote positive energy flow and well-being.
  • Sustainability Focused: Solar water heating, EV charging stations, and energy-efficient LED lighting are just a few of the eco-friendly features.
  • Luxury Meets Nature: Situated in Greenwood, Dubai’s greenest neighborhood, offering vast open spaces, parks, and nature-inspired amenities.
  • Comprehensive Amenities: Enjoy exclusive facilities like an oxygen bar, yoga and meditation parks, a hydroponic vertical garden, and a private school within the community.

location_tile.title: Kensington Gardens: Eco-Friendly Living Meets Urban Convenience
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Kensington Gardens is situated in Greenwood, one of Dubai’s newest and most eco-friendly communities, developed by Nakheel. With its lush open spaces and proximity to key areas of Dubai, Greenwood offers the perfect blend of convenience and tranquility. Located just 16 minutes from Downtown Dubai, this strategically positioned community provides easy access to major highways, including Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311) and Emirates Road (E611), as well as the Dubai Blue Metro line.

Within the Greenwood neighborhood, residents have access to a range of facilities including the expansive 99,000 sq.m. Central Park, retail outlets, a supermarket, private schools, healthcare services, and a hospital. With 460,000 square meters of open space, jogging and cycling tracks, yoga and meditation parks, and dedicated play areas for children, the location offers an active, family-friendly lifestyle in harmony with nature.

  • Downtown Dubai – 16 minutes
  • Dubai International Airport – 20 minutes
  • Global Village – 10 minutes
  • Mall of the Emirates – 15 minutes
  • Dubai Marina – 25 minutes
